# Pravara Mes

Compact LLM context index for this repository. PravaraMES is the MADFAM
Manufacturing Execution System: it owns fabrication routing and dispatch for
physical jobs (orders, tasks, machines, telemetry, quality).

## Read first

- `AGENTS.md` — canonical agent operating instructions, including
  «Repo facts» (what deploys, toolchains, gates).
- `README.md` — product overview, API, «Testing», «Deployment» and
  «Related repositories / contracts».
- `ROADMAP.md` — status table (with a "Deployed" column) and the one
  canonical pending-work list: «Pending work and roadmap ahead».
- `ECOSYSTEM.md` — MADFAM ecosystem and Enclii deployment context (generated;
  do not hand-edit).
- `llms-full.txt` — full context map and durable operating contract.

## Deployed vs not deployed

Deployed by GitOps: pravara-api, telemetry-worker, pravara-ui,
pravara-landing, pravara-gateway (Centrifugo), pravara-admin. Not built or
deployed: visualization-engine, video-streaming (does not build),
ml-orchestrator, luban-bridge, octoprint-connector, machine-adapter (runs on
site boxes as the Sparkplug B edge node; kit in `deploy/edge/`). The
telemetry worker can run the Sparkplug primary host (off by default); edge
enrollment and broker auth are in
`docs/operations/sparkplug-broker-and-enrollment.md`.

## Production operations

Routine production operations are Enclii-first. Use Enclii web, API, or CLI
before raw infrastructure tools. Direct `kubectl`, `helm`, SSH, provider CLIs,
`docker exec`, or direct container access is bootstrap/break-glass only.
